targets.old_statement: Arrow boards sketch the coming bend with safe-speed hints below, and guide boards, mostly tall rectangles, name places, roads and routes onward.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Arrow boards sketch the coming bend with safe-speed hints below, and guide boards, mostly tall rectangles, name places, roads and routes onward.
targets.statement: Signs posted before turns and curves use the arrow's shape to show what to expect and may carry a small sign below showing the maximum safe speed, while guide signs—most of which are rectangular—tell where you are, what road you are on, and how to reach destinations.
